title: Lightweight Ops Orbit Checklist — cross-team quick rollup
body:
Lightweight Ops Orbit — Quick Rollup
Purpose: one-page, hourly/daily rollup for micro-blockers, quick handoffs, and decisions that don’t need a full RFC. Use for cross-team syncs (<= 15m) and async status updates.

Columns: id, request_team, owner, priority, blocking, status, eta, action, notes, linked_ticket

ORB-001,Platform-Engineering,Marco Rivera,P0,Yes,Investigating,2027-04-14,assign on-call SRE and escalate to infra lead,KV cache invalidation producing higher tail latency on private deployment, JIRA-7799
ORB-002,Product-Hosted-API,Ethan Park,P1,Partial,Waiting for input,2027-04-15,product to confirm expected QPS; eng to provide interim fallback,Spike to add short-circuit cache TTL; observed 25% increase in token cost on small burst tests,JIRA-7812
ORB-003,Solutions-Eng,Linh Tran,P2,No,In progress,2027-04-18,SE to provide sample config for customer A,customer asking for dedicated model pin + canary policy; blocked on infra capacity forecast,CONFLUENCE-REQ-324
ORB-004,Security,Anika Bose,P1,No,Blocked,2027-04-20,security to sign off on KMS key rotation plan,waiting on third-party KMS questionnaire,SEC-490
ORB-005,Customer-Success,Jonas Meyer,P3,No,Done,2027-04-09,CS provided workarounds to customer,Resolved - temporary rate-limiter tweak pushed,CUST-1345

Quick notes / scratchpad:
- Orbital scrub cadence: daily 10:30am PT (Mon-Fri) for high-priority items; weekly deep-dive Friday 4pm PT.
- If "blocking" = Yes, escalate to oncall + product-ops lead immediately.
- Use this sheet for short-lived items; move to project board if ETA > 2 weeks.

Open questions / follow-ups:
- ORB-001: Marco to confirm whether KV cache mis-keys happen only for private deployments or also Dedicated. (Action: Marco, due 2027-04-13)
- ORB-002: Product to confirm QPS SLO and if temporary quota bump is acceptable for first 24 hours of rollout. (Action: Ethan)
- Who owns moving ORBs to product backlog? Default: product-ops unless specified.

Unresolved manual steps (notes to self):
- Quick checklist to hand off when marking item Done: add final comment + link to PR/JIRA, set resolution in tracker, ping cs if customer impacted.
- Reminder: capture minimal repro steps for infra to triage (timestamp, route, sample payload).

Last scrubbed by: Priya Nair (2027-04-12)
Slack thread references: #ops-orbit, #prod-release, see pinned message for quick incident playbooks.

Owner contact: priya.nair@redwood.com
_comment: Flat JSON per agents.md: all fields are strings or lists of strings, no nested objects. Body contains the sheet-like content and informal notes.
